raw_response:
This small plot of sorghum is just a corner of my land — only 0.08 hectare — so I cannot waste money on it. I went to school a little, so I know fertilizer helps, but one full bag of urea is too much for such a small piece and costs plenty. I will put a small amount of NPK that I share from the bag I bought for my other plots, and I will carry some manure from my goats and sheep because that costs me nothing. I keep my own sorghum seed from last harvest like my father did — it germinates well here and I trust it. My sons and I will do the work ourselves; no need to hire anybody for such a small patch, and rain is what I have, no irrigation here in the North West on this plot.
